data.narrative:
Nominal is a Series B-2 stage AI & Software company with a current $1B valuation and $155M in total capital raised. The peer universe for this stage and sector is constrained: while 11 AI & Software companies exist in our database, the combination of stage and valuation criteria yields insufficient comparable companies (0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 2 similar-tier peers). The broader peer set includes 1 public company (Palantir, PLTR) and 8 private companies, with top-tier private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable given the sparse narrow comp set. Standard multiples-based analysis would require either relaxing stage filters or accepting high dispersion across the broader AI & Software cohort—both approaches introduce material interpretation risk. The public anchor (Palantir) operates at a substantially later stage and different scale profile, limiting direct comparability.

The $1B valuation cannot be independently corroborated from comparable company analysis given data constraints. Key uncertainties include: (1) revenue/profitability metrics for Nominal itself, which would enable revenue multiple or SaaS-style DCF benchmarking; (2) stage-specific growth and margin trajectories for the narrower peer set; and (3) the relevant public market multiple applicable to an early-stage AI software business. Further valuation work would require either expanded comp definition, internal financial detail on Nominal, or reliance on alternative methods such as DCF with explicit assumption stress-testing.
